properties.notes: There are several planning approvals for this site (06/03071/OUTM; 11/01077/REMM;14/00616/FULM). The original Outline permission included proposals for a wider mixed use development, but viability issues has subsequently resulted in further approvals for just additional residential uses. The site has had planning permission implemented (development platform created), but that scheme is no longer being delivered and no houses have been built. Likely that a fresh application will be required therefore.. Residential development for 930 dwellings. http://www.doncaster.gov.uk/services/planning/planning-applications-online-public-access
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
